name: Sam Sample
headline: Sam Sample,
on three frequencies.
lede: A fictional creator used to test the showcase container. Every word here is made up; no real person or business is described.

sources.label: example.com
sources.usedFor: placeholder source for the test fixture

disclaimer: A test fixture for the OurWKRP creator showcase. Sam Sample is fictional.

values.title: How many, never who.
values.body: The showcase reports counts, not identities, and any count below five is withheld and shown in words.

sponsorship.title: Sponsors on the creator's terms.
sponsorship.body: A sponsor appears only where both sides said yes, and sees only the counts for what it backed.

stations.title: Evening workshops
stations.intro: Short practical workshops for neighbours, two evenings a month.
stations.online: A sign-up page and a few short clips.
stations.live: The workshop itself, in the hall.
stations.track: One link per workshop, counted from the clip and the door QR as totals per source.
stations.report: Attendance per workshop and the source that brought people in. Any count under five reads Fewer than 5.
stations.sponsor: A local hardware shop credited on the workshop page.
stations.why: Practical skills for neighbours, free or pay what you can.

stations.title: Market stall
stations.intro: Hand-made goods sold from a stall at the weekend market.
stations.live: The stall, with a QR on the table card and on each tag.
stations.track: Scans from a tag or table card into the shop, counted per market day.
stations.report: Which market day moved which goods, as counts.
stations.choice: Which goods go to which market.
stations.why: Made goods, sold where people already gather.

stations.title: The organizer's view
stations.intro: One view across the workshops and the stall.
stations.online: Every channel above, on one dashboard.
stations.live: Every room the creator is in.
stations.report: One combined report. Sponsors see only their part.
stations.sponsor: Season sponsors instead of single events.

schedule.intro: Two dates from the fixture's own pages.
